title: The Flavor of Non-Abelian Orbifolds
summary: In string model building, flavor symmetries can arise from the geometric features of the compactification space. In the case of heterotic orbifold models, modular and traditional flavor symmetries can be related to both geometric and algebraic properties of the orbifold space group. Our goal is to study the origin of moduli-independent discrete flavor symmetries in symmetric heterotic orbifolds with non-Abelian point groups.
